name: github-actions-pr-traceable-to-work
description: GitHub Action that requires pull requests to link to an Azure DevOps work item or GitHub issue

scripts.package: ncc build lib/main.js --out dist --source-map --license licenses.txt && printf '%s\n' '{"type":"commonjs"}' > dist/package.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run package && vitest run
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run package
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run format-check && npm run test && npm run verify-package

author: Joost Voskuil
